assertions.name: G1_hecke_relation
assertions.source: sigma^2 = h sigma + 1 for the Jimbo R at q = 2, 3 (exact).

assertions.name: G2_framing_corrected_trace_is_markov_invariant
assertions.source: q^(-2 writhe) Tr(K^n rho) is unchanged by positive and negative stabilisation on four samples at q = 2, 3, exactly.

assertions.name: G3_parity_holds_on_every_word
assertions.source: n + #components is even for every gamma-gamma word enumerated on 3 and 5 strands (Lean gammaGamma_components_parity).

assertions.name: G4_none_on_three_strands
assertions.source: no gamma-gamma word on 3 strands (<= 6 vertices) closes to three components with linking pattern {1,0,0}: three components force the identity permutation, all components are single strands with no self-crossings, so writhe = 2 lk = +-2, but every gamma-gamma word has writhe 0.

assertions.name: G5_report_five_strand_matches
assertions.source: 86 gamma-gamma words on 5 strands (<= 6 vertices) have the invariant of e- + nu-bar or its mirror at q = 2 and 3; smallest vertex counts {'e- + nu-bar': 3, 'mirror (e+ + nu)': 3}. Evidence of isotopy, not a proof. None is selected.

description: Which gamma-gamma words close to the lepton pair e- + nu-bar (Hopf link + unknot): parity, writhe, and an exact framing-corrected quantum invariant at q = 2, 3. Nothing selected or scored.
